title: Thomassen: exponentially many 5-list-colourings of planar graphs
abstract: A Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of C. Thomassen, Exponentially many 5-list-colorings of planar graphs (J. Combin. Theory Ser. B 97, 2007): a finite planar graph with n vertices, every vertex of which has a list of at least five colours, has at least 2^{n/9} distinct list colourings (two_rpow_card_div_nine_le_ncard_listColourings: (2 : ℝ) ^ (n / 9) ≤ the number of maps f : V → C with f v ∈ L v and f u ≠ f v on every edge). Planarity is combinatorial: a plane map is a rotation system whose hypermap with the dart reversal has Euler defect 0 (definitions copied verbatim from the registered entry thomassen-girth-five, PALOMAR-2026-10-28-000023, so that the Challenge depends on Mathlib only). The proof follows the paper: Theorems 1–4, Claims 8–13 and the lemmas on generalized wheels they use are proved for an abstract interface of near-triangulations, which is realised by plane near-triangulations using the separation theorems of the dependency; every planar graph is a spanning subgraph of a plane near-triangulation. One statement; the definitions of the Challenge are compared with those of the Solution.
